1914
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12
Page 23 1914
Oct. 12 1st Anniversary of laying of Corner stone "Irish Night" brought in over $1200
Dec. 26-7-8 "Holy Night" was a success. but no doubt would have done more good and probably would have brought in more than $350.00 had Admission been about 25¢ instead of 50¢ & 75¢
1915 In Nomine Christi 1915
O.M.Cap. Contest for set of Vestments between Rev. John O Donovan of Harlem and his classmate Rev. Fr. Solanus of Yonkers. in February to conclude May 25th
Pages 24 to 81 are all blank
Pages 82 End of book has 14 pages of names and dues paid. to 95 The handwriting is by several persons. The last 6 pages may be by Fr. Solanus. - Just names of servers listed.
